hero.eyebrow: From wherever you are, for your family in Cuba

hero.sub: Pick products we already have on the island, pay in dollars by card, and we show you the photo when your family receives it.
hero.perkCutoff: Order before {time} and it arrives today

how.title: How it works
how.lead: Four steps, no paperwork. You can browse the shop without an account; you need one to order.

choose.title: Build your combo
choose.text: Pick the products and quantities. Each one shows its price and whether it is available.

who.title: Tell us who receives it
who.text: Name, two phone numbers and the address. We save your relatives so the next order is faster.

pay.title: Pay by card
pay.text: You pay in dollars on a secure payment page. We never see your card details.

receive.title: We deliver, you see it
receive.text: We prepare the order in Cuba and bring it to the door. You get an email and can see the delivery confirmation.

why.title: Why food-combos
why.lead: Made for people sending care from far away who want peace of mind.

speed.title: It arrives today, not in weeks
speed.text: The products are already in Cuba. There is no international shipping in between, so delivery is the same day or the next.

proof.title: You see it arrived
proof.text: When we deliver we record who received the order and attach the delivery photo. You see it on your order page.

stock.title: Honest stock
stock.text: Every product says whether it is in stock, running low or sold out. No surprises after you pay.

pay.title: Clear prices, in dollars
pay.text: You see the total before paying: products plus your municipality’s delivery fee. No hidden charges.
pay.textFree: You see the total before paying: products plus your municipality’s delivery fee. Delivery is free from {amount}.

gift.title: With a message from you
gift.text: Add a few words to the order and they arrive with the products.

language.title: In Spanish and English
language.text: The whole shop is in both languages, so your kids can place the order too.

shop.title: What you can send
shop.lead: A taste of the shop. Browse the full catalog and build the combo your way.

where.title: Where we deliver
where.lead: We deliver to these municipalities, with a flat delivery fee for each.
where.leadFree: We deliver to these municipalities, with a flat delivery fee for each. Delivery is free on orders from {amount}.

visit.title: Hours and contact
visit.lead: If you have questions before ordering, write or call us.

howLong.a: Orders paid before {time} (Cuba time) are delivered the same day; later ones, the next day.
howLong.aNoCutoff: We deliver the same day or the next, depending on when your payment is confirmed.

pay.a: By card, in dollars, on a secure payment page. We never see or store your card details.

account.a: You can browse the shop and build your combo without one. To pay you create one with your email and a password, and confirm your email once.

where.q: Who and where can I send to?
where.a: To anyone you choose, in the municipalities listed above. We ask for their name, two phone numbers and the address, with reference points so the courier can find it.

proof.q: How do I know it arrived?
proof.a: When we deliver we record who received the order and the delivery photo. You see it on your order page and we email you.

gift.a: Yes. When you place the order you can write a message and we deliver it with the products.

cancel.q: Can I cancel or get a refund?
cancel.a: You can cancel while the order is unpaid. After paying, write to us and we will sort it out together.

cta.title: Build your first combo today
cta.text: Browse the shop, pick what your family needs, and we take care of delivering it.

footer.tagline: Combos for your family in Cuba
